Fixed Monthly Payment — Snowball Payoff

Commit one amount each month instead of letting every loan run on its own payment. Each loan keeps its minimum; whatever is left over goes to the smallest remaining balance, and rolls onto the next smallest as each one is cleared. Estimates only — nothing here is saved.

Add Loan

Enter a balance greater than 0.
This balance is tracked from the loan's payment history. Editing it here re-aligns that tracking so the balance matches the number you enter — your logged payments are all kept.

Add Investment

What you expect this to make per year, to as many as 4 decimals (e.g. 3.6125). Drives the projection and the "beating expectations?" check — it never changes a recorded value.
